items.difficulty_reason: 证明 103 行、五条结论分三段打：①(1)(2) 用第一个谱序列加高次顺像的拟凝聚性与收敛性；②(3) 用「拟紧开集上的归纳原理」把问题化到仿射情形（并集步用相对 Mayer-Vietoris 三角形 + tor amplitude 在三角形中的行为），仿射情形再用 Leray 无环性与仿射态射高次顺像消没把顺像复形写成平坦模的有界复形；③(4)(5) 用投影公式把问题化为比较映射是同构，再在仿射情形通过「与直和交换」（单度数靠拟凝聚性、一般情形靠对复形长度归纳 + 展示的三角形）完成。作者在 (5) 末尾写了一句 `Some details omitted.`（指的是紧接在前面已展示三角形之后的归纳），已按项目规则逐字记入 editorial_notes。12 处引用（2 同章、10 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-cohomology-de-rham-base-change (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5770-5791

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to an affine base, the spectral sequence argument for local boundedness and quasi-coherence, the induction principle on quasi-compact opens with relative Mayer-Vietoris for finite tor dimension, and the two base change statements proved by the same cone and direct sum arguments (source lines 5793-5895)
